title: Phenotyping Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Cancer
official: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Cancer: Phenotyping of Patients at a Third-level Diabetes Centre

interventions.name: phenotyping of patients followed at a third-level diabetes centre with cancer

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Legal age
* Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of cancer before diagnosis of type 2 diabetes
* Diagnosis of diabetes secondary to other diseases
* Diagnosis of diabetes secondary to other drugs
* Diagnosis of diabetes following surgery
sponsor: Azienda Ospedaliero Universitaria Maggiore della Carita
